claim_review.claim: The mother places one egg inside the cockroach egg case.
The young feeds on the dozen or more cockroach eggs inside.
Adult about a quarter inch long; stalked rear section resembles a signal flag, moves up and down, and explains the name.

A homeowner can leave this identified ensign wasp alone.
